build_text_video_gpt_model: build a text-to-video GPT model with configurable sequence lengths and pretrained weights
build_text_video_gpt_with_pretrained: build a text-to-video GPT model using pretrained MUGEN weights for L32 sequence length
create_text_tokenizer: create a TextTokenizer that encodes sentences to padded token IDs with unique padding
encode_sentences_to_tokens: encode a list of sentences into token IDs with unique padding on a device
decode_token_ids_to_sentences: decode token IDs back into human-readable sentences using the TextTokenizer
